description: Creates a document from a template and emails it to the listed signers for signature; the document contents are shared with every listed address. The order of the signers array assigns template roles: the first signer gets the first role, and so on. The document is sent as-is; its fields are completed by the signers. Returns the new document id. A repeated request_id returns the original document instead of sending again. With dry_run, validates everything and reports what would be sent without sending. A sent document can be cancelled only by the account owner, from the AddSign dashboard.

dry_run.description: true = validate everything (recipients, template roles, plan limits) and report exactly what would be sent, without creating or emailing anything

message.description: Personal note included in the signature-request email

request_id.description: Idempotency key: a request repeating an earlier request_id returns the original document instead of sending again

signers.description: One signer per template role — array position IS the role assignment

signing_order_type.description: parallel (default): everyone signs at once; sequential: one at a time in order

title.description: Document title; defaults to the template name

name: send_for_signature
title: Send a document for signature
